summary: Second iteration focused on new Jev (TypeSafe decision model) features. Backend: 19/19 pytest tests PASSED (/app/backend/tests/test_jev_features.py) covering: (a) POST /api/categorize — Urdu/Roman-Urdu/English notes correctly map to grocery (آٹا اور چینی), education (bachon ki tuition fee), milk_veg (دودھ اور سبزی), transport (petrol dalwaya) with confidence in [0,1] and ai_classified=true; empty body rejected 422; no mongo _id leak. (b) POST /api/parse source=sms — OTP, received, balance-only all return is_spend=false with correct sms_kind (otp/received/balance) and amount=0; real JazzCash debit SMS returns is_spend=true, sms_kind='spend', amount=1250, method=jazzcash; source='text' still returns is_spend=true, sms_kind=null. (c) POST /api/expenses spend_level — 120 PKR milk categorized as 'normal' (not unusual); 45000 PKR guests categorized as slightly_high/unusual (both acceptable). Bill pay (/api/bills/{id}/pay) creates a child expense with spend_level=null (no Jev call for scheduled bills) as designed. Light regression: /, /summary, /bills, /udhaar, /report all 200. Frontend (mobile 390x844): add-expense modal verified end-to-end — typing 'دودھ اور سبزی' in expense-note-input auto-selects milk_veg chip after ~600ms and shows auto-category-hint; tapping grocery chip first (catTouched=true) prevents further auto-override even after retyping the note; pasting an OTP SMS fires sms-parse-button and shows toast 'یہ تصدیقی کوڈ کا پیغام ہے، اس میں کوئی خرچ نہیں' with amount left empty; received SMS shows 'یہ پیغام رقم ملنے کا ہے، خرچ نہیں'; a real JazzCash debit SMS correctly fills amount=1250; saving a 48000-PKR guests expense displays the unusual-level toast 'خرچ محفوظ ہو گیا — یہ معمول سے بڑا خرچ ہے، باقی دن ذرا ہاتھ روک کر'. Regression nav: tab-index, tab-udhaar, tab-bills, tab-report all load cleanly.
critical_code_review_comments: jev_ask correctly swallows TypeSafeAPIError / TypeSafeError and returns None so endpoints degrade gracefully (categorize returns null+ai_classified=false, spend_level stays None, SMS falls through to LLM parse). Good resilience pattern.
/api/parse SMS path: non-spend branch guarded by confidence>=0.6 — reasonable threshold, prevents false negatives on ambiguous SMS by falling through to LLM parse.
pay_bill uses insert_expense directly (no spend_check) — intentional and verified by test_bill_pay_does_not_run_spend_check (spend_level=null on resulting bills expense).
server.py now at 487 lines — still under 700-line guideline but trending up; consider splitting resources (expenses/bills/udhaar) into routers if more features arrive.
Add-expense auto-categorize uses a monotonic ref (catTurn) to drop stale LLM responses — correct pattern for debounced autocompletes.
seed_data_creation: Test-created expenses (TEST milk 120, TEST guests 45000, TEST bill 1800) auto-cleaned by test teardowns. Two UI-created expenses (45000 guests, 48000 guests) removed post-run via DELETE /api/expenses. DB clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Jev tests at /app/backend/tests/test_jev_features.py. If Jev CAPACITY_LIMIT (429) is transient, the tests pytest.skip rather than fail — they only hard-assert obvious cases (grocery for 'آٹا اور چینی', method=jazzcash on JazzCash debit SMS, spend_level!=unusual for 120 PKR milk). Add-expense modal flow: open via [data-testid=add-expense-fab]; auto-category-hint appears ~1-3s after typing in expense-note-input; SMS toast message is captured via MutationObserver on [data-testid=toast-message] since toasts dismiss quickly.
